description: Turn Google Keyword Planner reads into an immutable local evidence portfolio for offline research and safe warehouse handoff.

novel_features.name: Evidence trace
novel_features.description: Trace one stored monthly value back to the exact request and raw receipt that produced it.

novel_features.name: Coverage accountability
novel_features.description: See requested, returned, missing, unavailable, raw-only, and incomplete coverage for a saved collection.

novel_features.name: Variant-aware lineage
novel_features.description: Follow submitted keywords through returned terms and close variants without double-counting demand.

novel_features.name: Immutable snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Compare two preserved collections to see changed terms, monthly values, flags, and coverage.

novel_features.name: Portfolio integrity check
novel_features.description: Verify that raw receipts, hashes, normalized rows, and coverage still reconcile.

novel_features.name: Policy-safe local statistics
novel_features.description: Compute descriptive monthly aggregates while excluding unavailable, ambiguous, anomalous, and incomplete rows.
